payload.title: The agent policy document: rung, overrides and pause, per site
payload.description:
One versioned document per site (a `SiteDocument` of kind `agents`, body in S3, admin-only, with who, when and why on every version). For each responsibility it holds the rung: `off`, `observe` (reads and records what it would do), `propose` (files suggestions), `draft` (writes drafts and candidates nobody outside sees), `prepare` (takes work to the door and asks a person), `publish_soft` (goes unless a person stops it in time), `publish_auto` (goes; shown in the digest). Optional overrides narrow it by section, Story type, channel, Announcement kind or list; the narrowest wins. It also holds `paused` per agent and for the whole site, the quiet window, the loop limit, the budget and the model tier (used by later tasks). A new site starts with every agent at `off` or `observe`. Each run records the policy version and rung it ran under. Only an admin may change it; an agent is blocked.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A rung change is a new version with who, when and why.
- The narrowest matching override decides.
- A paused agent starts nothing and records why.
- Every run names the policy version it ran under.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- agent-policy.feature: a new site starts quiet; an admin raises a rung with a reason; an editor and an agent cannot; a section override beats the site rung; pausing stops new runs; resuming does not replay skipped ticks; a run records its policy version.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** Amplify data: new `SiteDocument` kind (no new table).

**Part of:** Authorization: the autonomy ladder as configuration. Slice code E1 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
